covered.rule: A s1: 1 to 45 days late on one product
A s2: address as title plus last name; now drives all dates
A 1: opening - digital assistant from Freya Bank, call recorded
covered.where: phrases.opening (opening_verbatim=false: content only, not dictated words)

covered.rule: A 1: do not say collections/debt/payment/product before verification, applies to relatives
A 2: "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?"
A 3: only yes/that's me/speaking/own name; ask once more; then not_reached/unclear
A 4: robot/AI question
A 5: third party - say nothing beyond opening, ask when reachable
A 6: callback today/next business day 10:00-19:00 inclusive, after now
A 7: ask once for another time, else not_reached/no_callback
A 8: wrong number
A 9: deceased, "I am sorry for your loss."
A 10: relative may not answer security questions or be told anything
A 11: DOB then phone last 4; YYYY-MM-DD; numeric dates day-month-year
A 12: three wrong answers in total
A 13: hint day_month_swapped, ask month as a word, not counted
A 14: after three wrong - app or branch, not_verified/failed
A 15: explain once, then not_verified/declined; asking purpose counts as declining
A 16-17: get_account; collections team about a late payment; product naming; amount and days late
A s7: business days Mon-Fri, holidays list
A 18 table: early 1-7 12th business day 1 attempt; late 8-45 7th business day 2 attempts
A 19: promise today or later, business day, not after deadline
A 20: weekend/holiday -> next business day
A 21: vague period - ask once then propose deadline
A 22: next/this weekday
A 23: after deadline - offer deadline; refusal = flat refusal
A 24: full first, never ask how much
A 25: floors minimum_payment / instalment_amount
A 26: floor once, 'the rest stays overdue'
A 27: accept floor..full; below floor offer floor once
A 28: "Can you make this payment today?"
A 29-30: persuasion attempts; attempt 1 last business day this week (or next); attempt 2 floor on deadline
A 31: attempts used up -> no_promise/refused
A 32: hardship - sympathy, offer support transfer, decline -> no_promise/hardship, before rules 30 and 41, customer may still promise
A 33: no discount/waiver/plan
A 34: read back, "Do you confirm?"
A 35: changes at read-back re-checked
A 36: one promise per product; change in mobile app
A 37: retry once, then service_error
A 38: "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."
A 39: already paid
A 40: dispute incl. closed/paid off in the past
A 41: restructuring transfer
A 42: human - ask once, then general queue
A 43: scam reply
A 44: cannot answer
A 45: says twice does not want to talk
A 46 table + transfer after promise -> transferred
A: Brief A never uses add_note (overridden by Brief B)
A 47: thank and say goodbye before close_call
B 1: one to three products
B 2: state every late product before asking
B 3: band/deadline per product
B 4: ask all today once, then products in get_account order from attempt 1
B 5: attempts per product
B 6: common date clamped to each product's deadline
B 7: one read-back, one confirmation, create_promise per product
B 8: add_note for each unpromised product with listed reasons
covered.where: notes.enabled, notes.reasons (all in add_note enum), notes.note_each_unpromised_product

covered.rule: B 9: dispute/already paid on one product does not end the call
B 10: restructuring - recorded promises stay, unrecorded dropped, no notes on any transfer
B 11: failed create_promise -> keep recorded, note service_error
B Closing: all paid -> paid; else no_promise with first non-paid note reason; promise wins except rule 10
